text: ピジョットで　とんで　きたッス　かいけつ　した…？

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb with くる means doing that action on the way here. とんで　きた = 'came flying'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here tells what was used to do it. ピジョットで = 'by Pidgeot'.

patterns.name: 〜です
patterns.explanation: ッス is a squashed です used by young men trying to sound casually polite. きたッス = 'I came, sir'.
